title: PUBLIC NOTICE CIRCULAR 02 - 2025: Introduction of an Online Electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) Portal for the Continuation of National Registration of Suppliers, Contractors, and Consultants
publisher: National Public Procurement Authority, Sierra Leone
why_not: fetched and read in full; the circular concerns mandatory online registration of suppliers, contractors and consultants, the documents required and the registration fees, and says nothing about publishing, licensing or opening government data, so it does not evidence movement on open data policy
